packs.title: Angular application
packs.description: The default-on Angular and language-independent rules for an Angular single-page application. .NET rules and opt-in rules stay off.

packs.title: .NET service or API
packs.description: The default-on .NET and language-independent rules for an ASP.NET Core API, worker or CLI. Angular rules and opt-in rules stay off.

packs.title: Quality Studio house style
packs.description: Every rule the library marks defaultOn. This is the shipped default: a repository without an applicability file resolves exactly this pack, which is the behaviour before rule packs existed.

packs.title: Public website (SEO)
packs.description: The opt-in search-discovery rules for HTML that is intentionally published for search engines. Combine it with the pack of the site's technology; it adds no obligations to private applications.

packs.title: Security baseline
packs.description: Every rule that covers the security review kind, in every technology. Language-independent rules that also cover code or performance keep those kinds. For a repository that should be reviewed for security without the house style, such as vendored or integration code.
